description: Unauthorized S3 Bucket Access Misconfigured bucket policies, overly permissive IAM roles, or disabled bucket public access blocks could allow unauthorized access to sensitive data. An attacker could exploit misconfigured bucket permissions to list, download, or modify sensitive data in the S3 buckets.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Implement strict S3 bucket policies and enable block public access settings

description: Insecure Data Transmission Without proper encryption in transit and endpoint validation, data could be intercepted during transmission or sent from unauthorized endpoints. An attacker could perform a man-in-the-middle attack to intercept data being uploaded to S3 or use compromised credentials to upload malicious data.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1048 - Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
recommendation: Implement strong encryption in transit and endpoint validation

description: Insufficient Key Management Lack of proper key rotation, storage, or access controls for encryption keys and secrets could lead to compromise. An attacker gaining access to unrotated keys or improperly stored secrets could decrypt sensitive data or gain unauthorized access to services.
references: recommendation: Implement comprehensive key management using AWS KMS

description: Insufficient Monitoring and Alerting Without proper monitoring and alerting, security incidents or system issues could go undetected or be detected too late for effective response.
